items.title: Darius Brubeck interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 29, 2024
items.q: If you’re doing a Neal Hefti chart and the sax section is sharp, it’s not going to sound good.

ctx.x: If you’re doing a Neal Hefti chart and the sax section is sharp, it’s not going to sound good. But if on the other hand you played a chart that would be somebody’s transcription of the African Jazz Pioneers, which was a terrific small big band back in the day, and they were trained like the musicians I interacted with a lot in England, you know to — you know they’d have their small group gigs but they’d be in the Ronnie Scott’s All- Stars, they’d be in the BBC Big Band, they came up through the National Jazz…
